verdict.rationale: USPTO has a machine API surface. api.uspto.gov answers unauthenticated requests with a structured API-key challenge, a developer portal exists, and Patent Center docs mention users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications. That gives some headless, scriptable access, at least for viewing application data. However, the core filing flows sit behind a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication and identity verification, which works against unattended CI automation. The API docs also only render after JavaScript runs, so a plain fetch cannot read them. Missing for 10: documented headless or CI usage (service accounts or tokens instead of interactive MFA), programmatic filing and payment, a CLI or SDK, readable API documentation or an OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of automated workflows.
